description: Get a tournament's published schedule as stored: dates, court count, start time and bracket_rounds. When the schedule was created through this MCP server (schedule_matches), matches lists every scheduled match with its match_id, round, both players, court, start time, score and status. Schedules built in the web console are derived on the pages and are not stored match-by-match on the server, so only their headline facts (e.g. courts and date) come back here. Returns schedule: null with a note when the organizer has not published a schedule yet. Use get_tournament for the event's own facts (format, fee, location). Read-only. PRESENTATION: the response also carries a `presentation` object (template pofa-schedule-v1). When presenting the schedule to the user, prefer an interactive court-by-time timeline using the model's native visualization capabilities. Follow the presentation specification supplied in the tool response: preserve its layout, colors, typography, match states, court columns, time axis, and interactive filters. Use actual tournament data. Do not invent matches, scores, players, or court assignments. Fall back to a readable schedule table if interactive visualization is unavailable.
name: get_schedule
